import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('/Users/bakulbadwal/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p02-xlsx-multisheet-sku/warehouse_stock.xlsx')

# Read all sheets and combine
all_data = []
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=sheet)
    df['Warehouse'] = sheet
    all_data.append(df)

combined = pd.concat(all_data, ignore_index=True)
print("Combined shape:", combined.shape)
print(combined)

# Group by SKU and sum Qty On Hand
sku_totals = combined.groupby('SKU')['Qty On Hand'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nSKU totals:")
print(sku_totals)

# Get the SKU with the largest total
max_sku = sku_totals.index[0]
max_qty = sku_totals.iloc[0]
print(f"\nSKU with largest total: {max_sku} (qty: {max_qty})")
